answer: Make each identity post a wander of hours worked for real clients, signed by those clients, before its votes weigh anything, and let the weight grow only as the square root of distinct signers. A farm splitting one operator into many seats keeps the same signers, so its total weight barely moves, while buying fake clients would cost more per seat than the yarrow it could then claim. Any seat whose anchor of signers collapses to one wallet is slashed, so stacking identities on a single client book is a loss.
